decisions.reason: Acceptance of preset and custom tip options does not change the Transak provider, conversion flow, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
The source defines selectable tip amounts but does not specify how tips are allocated or modify the existing $15 primary-mint revenue allocation.
Optional tips on the primary minting page do not alter secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, or ticket behavior.
The source accepts a tipping-page design but does not request any corresponding FAQ explanation or copy change.
The accepted tip controls do not entail a change to the About page content or its how-it-works copy.
Preset and custom tipping options do not change Big Block winners, prize amounts, funding sources, or draw triggers.
The source does not require tip amounts or tipping status to appear in NFT metadata and leaves existing metadata attributes unchanged.
The tipping configuration does not change ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, resets, or transfer behavior.
Preset and custom tipping options do not change Small Block winners, prize amounts, funding sources, or draw conditions.
The source does not connect tipping choices to badge eligibility, milestones, storage, icons, or effects.
Optional tipping does not alter the trigger, recipient selection, or reward components for mints without referral codes.
The tipping-page controls do not resolve or modify how prize winners collect their prizes.
